{{Top|leg|title=''Kempman'' group}}
The '''''Kempman'' group''' was a group of [[Container transport|Container Transports]] working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was destroyed by Imperial forces during their attack on [[Organarms]].
